description: Curated thesis cards for high-priority names whose raw exchange/profile mapping is too broad for trade reasoning. These overrides are merged on top of generated ThemeMiner company thesis cards.

2313.TW.name: 華通
2313.TW.thesis_label: AI server HDI / high-layer PCB / optical-module PCB
2313.TW.primary_business: 華通是台灣 PCB 與 HDI 板廠，核心不是被動元件，而是高密度互連板、高層板與通訊/伺服器相關 PCB。用在 AI 供應鏈時，重點應放在 AI server 主板、OAM/加速卡板、高速網通與 800G/1.6T 光模組 PCB 的規格升級。
2313.TW.ai_chain_position: AI server 與光通訊升級會拉高 PCB 層數、線寬線距與訊號完整性要求；華通比較像 AI 算力硬體第二層瓶頸的 PCB/HDI 受益者，不應被粗略歸為被動元件或電子通路。
2313.TW.non_ai_chain_position: 手機、通訊、衛星與消費電子 PCB 仍會影響營收與估值；需要用法說/財報確認 AI server 與高階通訊占比。
catalysts: AI server high-layer PCB mix upgrade
台系 PCB 族群量價同步時的補漲
risks: AI server/光通訊占比需要法說驗證
手機與消費電子循環可能稀釋 AI 純度
短線若跳空或爆量黑 K，laggard 優勢會快速消失
上游 CCL/ABF 轉弱時，PCB 擴散可能中斷

3533.TW.name: 嘉澤
3533.TW.thesis_label: CPU socket / high-speed connector / server platform transition
3533.TW.primary_business: 嘉澤是 CPU socket 與高階連接器廠，AI server 論述下的關鍵不是泛 PCB，而是伺服器平台升級、CPU socket 腳位/ASP 提升，以及 rack-scale 系統中高可靠連接器內容增加。
3533.TW.ai_chain_position: Agentic AI / CPU rack 敘事會讓 CPU socket、伺服器平台連接器與高速互連內容增加；嘉澤是台股 CPU socket 純度較高的觀察點。
3533.TW.non_ai_chain_position: 也受 PC/server 平台循環、Intel/AMD/ARM 平台節奏與客戶拉貨時點影響。
catalysts: CPU rack and agentic AI server platform refresh
美股 interconnect leader 續強
risks: 平台週期 timing 不連續
高價股流動性與籌碼波動放大
若無法站回 20 日線，可能只是反彈不是轉強
估值已反映部分 CPU socket 純度

2421.TW.name: 建準
2421.TW.thesis_label: AI server thermal / fan tray / cooling module
2421.TW.primary_business: 建準是風扇、散熱模組與馬達廠，AI server 題材中應歸在散熱/風扇/機櫃熱管理，而不是 PCB 或電子通路。它的交易價值來自 GB200/GB300/Vera Rubin 功耗上升後，風扇與散熱需求擴散到第二線 thermal names。
2421.TW.ai_chain_position: AI rack 功率密度上升讓風扇、fan tray、液冷周邊與熱管理需求一起擴散；建準是散熱題材中的 follower，不是 PCB/被動元件股。
2421.TW.non_ai_chain_position: 工業、車用、消費電子與傳統散熱需求仍影響營收；需要看伺服器散熱占比與毛利改善。
catalysts: 台股散熱 leader 續強後的二線補漲
量增站上均線時確認 diffusion
risks: 若 leader 散熱股轉弱，二線補漲容易失效
自動映射曾把建準誤掛到 PCB/被動元件，推薦時需強制校正 business fit
高成交爆量後可能進入短線過熱
伺服器散熱收入占比需法說驗證

8046.TW.name: 南電
8046.TW.primary_business: 南電是 IC 載板與 PCB 廠，AI server 的重點在 ABF 載板、高階封裝周邊與伺服器/網通板材需求，而不是一般 PCB 廣義同族群。
8046.TW.ai_chain_position: AI ASIC/GPU/CPU 封裝與高階伺服器平台升級會拉動 ABF/IC substrate 需求，是 PCB/載板鏈的核心觀察股。
8046.TW.non_ai_chain_position: PC、手機與傳統載板循環仍影響稼動率與毛利。
catalysts: AI ASIC and advanced package substrate demand
台光電/台燿/欣興/景碩等載板鏈強度擴散
risks: ABF 週期復甦若不如預期，估值修復會中斷
AI 載板占比與稼動率需要財報驗證

FORM.ai_chain_position: AI optical and compound-semiconductor ramps eventually need wafer-level test and probe cards; FORM is a picks-and-shovels test bottleneck candidate rather than a direct optical component stock.
catalysts: photonic test throughput becoming a shipment gate
semicap and probe-card capex cycle recovery
risks: photonic test is only part of diversified test revenue
semicap capex cycle can dominate short-term price
options leverage is dangerous if IV is elevated

TTMI.thesis_label: US high-layer PCB / defense electronics / AI server PCB
TTMI.ai_chain_position: AI server and networking systems raise PCB layer count, material requirement, and signal-integrity constraints; TTMI is a US PCB peer for Taiwan high-layer PCB names.
catalysts: US PCB peer confirmation for TW PCB laggards
risks: defense and industrial mix can obscure AI purity
earnings gaps can quickly make it overheated

STM.thesis_label: European power semiconductor IDM / 800V HVDC AI data-center power / SiC-GaN-MCU
STM.primary_business: STMicroelectronics 是歐洲大型 IDM，產品橫跨 MCU、power discrete、SiC/GaN/MOSFET、PMIC、MEMS/sensors、analog/RF 與 automotive/industrial semiconductors。它不是純 AI 股，但在 800V HVDC AI data-center power conversion 以及 EV/industrial power chain 裡有真產品與官方合作證據。
STM.ai_chain_position: AI 機櫃從傳統低壓配電走向 800V HVDC 後，需要更高效率的 SiC/GaN、隔離、PMIC、功率控制與板端電源轉換。ST 已有與 NVIDIA 相關的 800 VDC AI datacenter power conversion portfolio，是歐洲 power semiconductor leader/architecture signal。
STM.non_ai_chain_position: 汽車、工業、個人電子、通訊與 MCU/sensor 仍是主要基本盤；EV 庫存、歐洲半導體景氣與工業週期會直接影響估值與 earnings。
catalysts: NVIDIA 800 VDC AI data-center power-conversion collaboration
SiC/GaN/MOSFET content growth in AI racks and EV platforms
Q1 2026 demand recovery / normalized distribution inventory
data-center revenue expectation rising from design wins
risks: not a pure AI stock; auto/industrial cycle can dominate the P&L
convertible-bond issuance can create short-term overhang after a large rally
data-center revenue needs quarterly proof, not only architecture headlines
competition from Infineon, TI, ON, Rohm, Navitas and Wolfspeed
European ADR liquidity and EUR/USD factor can add noise

VSH.primary_business: Vishay Intertechnology 是全球被動元件與分立半導體供應商，產品包含電阻、電容、電感、二極體、MOSFET 與光電元件。它是美股被動元件/分立元件擴散的重要指標，不該漏出被動元件圖譜。
VSH.ai_chain_position: AI server 電源、板端供電與高壓/高可靠元件需求會帶動被動元件與分立元件；VSH 可作為美股 passive/discrete breadth 指標。
VSH.non_ai_chain_position: 汽車、工業、消費電子與傳統庫存循環仍是主要波動源。
catalysts: AI server board power content growth
risks: industrial/auto downturn can offset AI demand
若漲價只停留在亞洲供應鏈，VSH 的股價確認可能落後或失真
短線大漲後不再是 clean laggard

VPG.thesis_label: precision sensors / resistive foil / measurement components
VPG.ai_chain_position: AI infrastructure is a secondary driver through precision power, test and industrial sensing; VPG is better treated as precision measurement/passive-adjacent peer, not pure MLCC.
risks: precision sensor cycle can diverge from passive component cycle
small-cap liquidity and sharp post-earnings moves

ON.name: ON Semiconductor
ON.thesis_label: power semiconductor / SiC-MOSFET / AI rack power follower
ON.primary_business: onsemi supplies intelligent power and sensing semiconductors, including MOSFETs, SiC devices, power modules, image sensors, analog and power-management products. In the ThemeMiner graph it should be treated as a real power-semiconductor node, not a generic semiconductor fallback.
ON.ai_chain_position: AI rack power density and 800V/HVDC architecture can increase demand for efficient power conversion semiconductors. ON is a diversified power-semiconductor follower: useful for confirming US power-semi breadth, but less pure than a dedicated AI rack power architecture winner.
ON.non_ai_chain_position: Auto and industrial cycles remain the main earnings driver; EV/industrial inventory, SiC pricing and customer capex can dominate AI read-through.
catalysts: AI rack power conversion semiconductor content growth
risks: auto/industrial cycle can dominate the stock
SiC pricing and EV demand may offset AI power narrative
not a pure AI data-center power name
needs revenue or guidance proof before treating the AI thesis as core

TXN.name: Texas Instruments
TXN.thesis_label: analog power / 800V AI data-center power architecture signal
TXN.primary_business: Texas Instruments is a diversified analog and embedded-processing semiconductor supplier with large power-management, signal-chain, isolation, MCU and embedded exposure. In this graph it is a power-architecture signal because of its 800V data-center power work with NVIDIA, not a pure AI accelerator stock.
TXN.ai_chain_position: TI validates the 800V/HVDC AI rack power architecture layer. It should lead or confirm the power-semiconductor basket, but its revenue is diversified and the architecture signal can lead monetization by several quarters.
TXN.non_ai_chain_position: Broad industrial/auto analog cycles, capacity utilization and pricing are more important to near-term earnings than AI alone.
catalysts: power-management content growth in AI racks
risks: large diversified analog base dilutes AI purity
architecture signal may precede revenue by quarters
industrial inventory cycle can dominate price action

COHR.name: Coherent
COHR.thesis_label: InP lasers / optical components / AI datacenter photonics leader
COHR.primary_business: Coherent supplies optical materials, lasers, transceivers, components and compound-semiconductor products. For AI infrastructure it is a visible leader in optical components, InP/laser capacity and datacenter photonics.
COHR.ai_chain_position: AI scale-out networking raises optical bandwidth needs. Coherent is a leader signal for laser-source, InP photonics and CPO/pluggable optics constraints; it is less of a laggard and more of a benchmark for downstream optical diffusion.
COHR.non_ai_chain_position: Industrial lasers, telecom inventory and non-AI optical cycles can still move the stock.
catalysts: laser-source allocation and InP photonics constraints
risks: already a visible optical leader, so late entries can be crowded
telecom/datacom inventory cycles can obscure AI demand
CPO transition may reshuffle winners

LITE.name: Lumentum
LITE.thesis_label: datacom laser / EML-CW light source / AI optical leader
LITE.primary_business: Lumentum supplies optical and photonic components including datacom/telecom lasers and high-speed optical components. It is a laser/light-source leader signal for AI datacenter optical upgrades.
LITE.ai_chain_position: AI clusters need more optical links. Lumentum is tied to the light-source layer, where laser availability can become a bottleneck for 800G/1.6T and future CPO ramps.
LITE.non_ai_chain_position: Telecom/datacom inventory, customer program timing and optical pricing cycles remain important.
risks: large optical beta can overheat quickly
transition from pluggable optics to CPO can change supplier economics
customer program timing is lumpy

TER.name: Teradyne
TER.thesis_label: semiconductor ATE / AI accelerator and advanced-package test
TER.primary_business: Teradyne supplies automated test equipment for semiconductors, system test and robotics. In AI infrastructure it belongs to the test bottleneck layer: expensive accelerators, chiplets, HBM and advanced packages require more test coverage and longer test time.
TER.ai_chain_position: As AI chips become larger, more expensive and more complex, test intensity rises. TER is a visible ATE leader and peer/leader signal for probe-card and interface names such as FORM, 旺矽 and 穎崴.
TER.non_ai_chain_position: Broad semicap capex, smartphone/auto test and robotics cycles can dilute AI-specific read-through.
catalysts: AI accelerator and custom ASIC test demand
advanced packaging and HBM test complexity
risks: less hidden than smaller probe-card names
test equipment orders can be lumpy
robotics and non-AI segments can distract from test thesis

MRVL.name: Marvell Technology
MRVL.thesis_label: AI networking / custom silicon / optical DSP
MRVL.primary_business: Marvell is a data-infrastructure semiconductor company spanning custom cloud ASIC, high-speed interconnect, Ethernet switching/connectivity, optical DSP/electro-optics, and storage/data-center silicon.
business_segments: storage controller and data infrastructure silicon
MRVL.ai_chain_position: AI clusters need scale-out networking, custom accelerator/ASIC programs, and optical/electrical interconnect. MRVL is a visible platform leader that should lead or validate second-layer names such as precision timing, optical components, SiPh/CPO packaging, high-speed PCB, and AI networking components.
MRVL.non_ai_chain_position: Carrier, enterprise networking, storage and automotive cycles can dilute pure AI read-through; short-term stock behavior can be dominated by hyperscaler design-win timing and valuation.
catalysts: AI scale-out networking and Ethernet fabric demand
CPO and silicon photonics architecture validation
risks: already a discovered AI infrastructure leader after large rerating
option IV can be elevated after gap moves
custom ASIC revenue is program-lumpy and customer-concentrated
telecom/storage weakness can offset AI networking strength

SITM.thesis_label: precision timing / MEMS oscillator / AI data-center timing
SITM.ai_chain_position: AI data centers need low-jitter timing across networking, accelerators and high-speed interconnect; SiTime is a US precision-timing leader rather than a broad semiconductor peer.
risks: valuation sensitivity
timing content can be hard to isolate from broad semiconductor beta

AAOI.thesis_label: optical transceiver / laser module / AI data-center optics
AAOI.ai_chain_position: AI cluster scale-out increases 800G/1.6T optical demand; AAOI is a high-beta optical transceiver/module name used as a leader signal for photonics diffusion.
risks: high beta and gap risk
customer concentration
price may already discount near-term optical excitement

AXTI.ai_chain_position: InP/GaAs substrates sit upstream of lasers and photonic components; AXTI is a material chokepoint candidate for AI optical buildout.
risks: substrate demand can lag optical module orders
small-cap volatility and supply/customer concentration

MSFT.thesis_label: enterprise AI platform / Copilot / Azure cloud
MSFT.ai_chain_position: MSFT is the software-side leader signal: Azure AI consumes hardware capex, while Copilot/GitHub/Dynamics test whether agentic AI becomes paid enterprise workflow software.
catalysts: GitHub Copilot and enterprise agent adoption
risks: mega-cap beta may lag high-growth SaaS
AI capex can pressure margins
regulatory overhang

ORCL.thesis_label: AI cloud / database gravity / enterprise applications
ORCL.ai_chain_position: ORCL connects AI cloud capacity scarcity with enterprise database gravity; watch it as a bridge between infrastructure capex and software/data-platform monetization.
risks: capex-heavy AI cloud buildout
cloud competition
large deal timing can make numbers lumpy

NOW.ai_chain_position: NOW is one of the cleanest public-market reads on AI agents moving from demos into actual enterprise workflow execution.
risks: premium valuation
AI attach-rate proof required
enterprise budget digestion

CRM.thesis_label: CRM workflow / Agentforce / customer data cloud
CRM.ai_chain_position: CRM is a customer-facing AI agent and enterprise workflow proxy; it works best when Agentforce/Data Cloud adoption is confirmed by billings and revenue acceleration.
risks: AI narrative may outrun customer adoption
large CRM base can slow growth
competition from Microsoft

SNOW.thesis_label: AI data platform / governed data cloud
SNOW.ai_chain_position: SNOW is the laggard-style software read-through for agentic AI: models and agents need governed enterprise data before they can execute useful work.
risks: consumption optimization
Databricks/hyperscaler competition
AI workloads may not offset core warehouse slowdown quickly

PLTR.ai_chain_position: PLTR is the high-beta proof point that AI software can become an operating layer for defense and commercial workflows, not just a chat interface.
risks: very high valuation
headline volatility
commercial growth must remain exceptional

DDOG.ai_chain_position: DDOG is the reliability layer for cloud and AI applications; more agents, APIs, and microservices create more telemetry, security, and cost-control demand.
risks: usage-based slowdown
cloud cost optimization
competitive bundling by hyperscalers

NET.thesis_label: edge cloud / SASE / AI traffic gateway
NET.ai_chain_position: NET links cloud security with AI traffic/API growth; it can lead if the market rotates from hardware capex into edge software, SASE, and inference gateways.
catalysts: AI Gateway and API security demand
risks: valuation sensitivity
SASE competition
edge AI monetization still early

CRWD.ai_chain_position: CRWD is the endpoint/XDR leader signal; if cyber software rotates, it should confirm with module expansion and relative strength versus PANW/ZS/NET.
risks: trust/execution after outages
premium valuation
security platform competition

PANW.ai_chain_position: PANW is the broad cybersecurity platform read-through; it validates whether enterprises consolidate network, cloud, endpoint and SOC automation spend into fewer platforms.
risks: billings transition volatility
large-company growth deceleration
platformization discounting

ZS.ai_chain_position: ZS is a pure SASE/zero-trust proxy; it should benefit when cloud apps, identity-aware access, and distributed enterprise security become the rotation focus.
catalysts: data protection and private access growth
risks: large deal lumpiness
competition from platform vendors
high valuation

MDB.thesis_label: operational database / vector search / AI app backend
MDB.ai_chain_position: MDB is an AI app backend proxy: agentic applications need state, document data, search and vector retrieval, not only data warehouses.
risks: database migration cycles are slow
consumption volatility
hyperscaler/database competition

ESTC.ai_chain_position: ESTC sits at the overlap of AI search, RAG/vector retrieval, observability and security analytics; useful as a smaller software laggard signal after SNOW/DDOG/NET move.
risks: open-source/hyperscaler competition
cloud consumption sensitivity
AI search demand can be hard to isolate

6214.TW.thesis_label: Taiwan system integration / enterprise cloud-AI implementation
6214.TW.ai_chain_position: 精誠是台股軟體/SI 核心節點；若美股 NOW/MSFT/SNOW/CRWD 帶出軟體輪動，台灣可能先看 SI、雲端與資安服務量價確認。
risks: 專案制收入波動
不是純 SaaS
題材需搭配成交量與月營收

3029.TW.ai_chain_position: 零壹是台股資安/雲端通路代理節點；美股資安若轉強，它可作為台灣資安題材擴散觀察股。
catalysts: 代理產品出貨與營收確認
risks: 通路毛利薄
跟隨題材而非全球平台龍頭
需量價與營收確認

6689.TW.thesis_label: Taiwan cloud-AI implementation / AWS ecosystem proxy
6689.TW.ai_chain_position: 伊雲谷是台股雲端/AI 實施代理；若美股 cloud AI 與 data platform 輪動，台股可用它觀察雲端專案與企業 AI adoption 的擴散。
risks: 雲端成本優化壓力
專案與代管收入節奏
流動性與題材輪動風險
